title: Saturanlian
summary: SATURAN'LIAN, adjective [from Latin saturnalia, feasts of Saturn.] 1. Pertaining to the festivals celebrated in honor of Saturn, Dec. 16, 17 or 18, in which men indulged in riot without restraint. Hen

inlines.v: SATURAN'LIAN, adjective [from Latin saturnalia, feasts of Saturn.] 1. Pertaining to the festivals celebrated in honor of Saturn, Dec. 16, 17 or 18, in which men indulged in riot without restraint. Hence, 2. Loose; dissolute; sportive.
